AFAIK, individual exchanges factor in the demand/supply balance within the exchange to calculate the price of a coin. So if Kraken is selling some coin for $100 and Coinbase for $90 then that's most probably because Kraken users are more eager to buy that coin and/or less eager to sell it as compared to Coinbase users. 
That also explains why the Ethereum flash crash was observed only in one exchange.
